short_horizon_movement_propagates_to_spo.meaning: short-horizon price movement propagates into spotEMA faster than into longer-horizon EMAs

twap_used_in_liquidation_checks.meaning: the computed TWAP is the value fed into liquidation solvency checks and the StaleOracle gate
twap_used_in_liquidation_checks.checkpoint: after TWAP computation, before liquidation check

stale_oracle_outcome_matches_expected.meaning: StaleOracle boundary outcome equals the outcome the intended smoothed TWAP (fastEMA, slowEMA, eonsEMA blend, spotEMA excluded) would produce: proceed when not stale, revert when stale

assumptions: The TWAP computed by twapEMA() is the value consumed by PanopticPool.getTWAP() for liquidation solvency checks and the StaleOracle gate.
Impacts are stated as potential, conditional on short-horizon price movement propagating into spotEMA faster than into longer-horizon EMAs.

unresolved.description: The report does not give a numeric definition of the StaleOracle boundary or the intended smoothed TWAP value, so the correspondence between the intended blend and the StaleOracle outcome is represented as a grounded Boolean rather than an arithmetic equality.

limitations: No concrete transaction, actor, or observed incident is described; the scenario is conditional on short-horizon price movement.
The StaleOracle boundary threshold and the intended TWAP arithmetic are not numerically specified in the report; code binding is deferred.
